comparison.objective: Clamp two glued boards with a wooden handscrew so both jaws bear flat along the joint.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual differential screw adjustment and force balancing to prevent jaw cant.
comparison.success_condition: The clamp remains holding the boards with flat jaw bearing; numeric force and alignment tolerances are not provided.
comparison.reason: Tests coupled screw adjustment and sustained clamping, unlike transient hammer impact, insert retention, and loose-tang recovery.
